reference.question: Each interior angle of a regular \(n\)-gon is \(140^\circ\). Find the value of \(n\).
reference.solution:
Method 1: Exterior-angle sum

The exterior angle is \(180^\circ-140^\circ=40^\circ\), so \(n=360^\circ\div40^\circ=9\).
